answer.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ. While promotional pricing (memory_73) directly addresses the competitive threat, it risks margin compression and may not address the underlying activation decline. Activation messaging (memory_91) directly targets the engagement drop and complements prior onboarding work (memory_31, memory_86). Verifying memory_31 and memory_91 will confirm the magnitude and durability of prior field-reduction and messaging lifts. This positions us to run a focused activation_messaging experiment that leverages proven in-product intervention patterns. The approach preserves long-term value by improving product engagement rather than trading margin for acquisition. If activation messaging shows <2% lift, we pivot to promotional pricing to defend against competitive pressure. This maintains optionality while addressing the core metric decline.
